title: Creating a Web API Project
description: Learn how to create a new ASP.NET Core Web API project.

data.text: Creating an ASP.NET Core Web API project is straightforward with the .NET CLI.

data.title: Create Project
data.content: Creating a new Web API project
data.code:
# Create new Web API project
dotnet new webapi -n MyWebApi
cd MyWebApi

# Run the project
dotnet run

# Or run with hot reload
dotnet watch run

data.title: dotnet watch
data.text: Use 'dotnet watch run' during development for automatic rebuilds when files change.

data.title: Key Takeaways
data.takeaway: Creating a Web API project is simple.
